role: adaptive development-only low-weight follow-up after the 0.003 teacher weight narrowly missed the endpoint gate
selection_rule: midpoint +/-80 m mean full L2 must improve over control and endpoint +/-160 m mean full L2 must be no more than 10% above control; among passing candidates select the lowest mean full L2 on the eight +/-80 and +/-280 m non-endpoint development records
limits: Adaptive follow-up selected after inspecting the first teacher-weight sweep. All weights are evaluated on the same spent development records and FD-derived pseudo-labels. One seed, one velocity model, 5 Hz, no independent validation and no localization test.
